trap.label: taught + to
trap.wrong: My grandfather taught me respect people.
trap.right: My grandfather taught me to respect people.
trap.why: Em português “me ensinou a respeitar” usa preposição a; o brasileiro omite o to inglês. Em inglês: teach someone to do.

fix.wrong: I realized what he was right.
fix.right: I realized that he was right.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado: “He teaches me to cook.”
Reescreva com used to: “He told me stories every night.”
rewrite.answer: He used to tell me stories every night.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com realize: “I understand he was right.” (passado)
rewrite.answer: I realized that he was right.
